description: Implementation of DeviceProfileService managing device profiles, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and certificate handling within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DeviceProfileServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing device profile management, including CRUD operations, caching, and certificate processing.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles cache eviction events for device profiles.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileById
methods.description: Retrieves a device profile by its ID, with optional cache update.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileByName
methods.description: Retrieves a device profile by its name.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileByProvisionDeviceKey
methods.description: Finds a device profile by its provision device key.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfoById
methods.description: Gets device profile info by ID.

methods.name: saveDeviceProfile
methods.description: Saves or updates a device profile, including certificate formatting and event publishing.

methods.name: deleteDeviceProfile
methods.description: Deletes a device profile by ID.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a device profile entity, with default profile check.

methods.name: removeDeviceProfile
methods.description: Removes a device profile and publishes eviction event.

methods.name: findDeviceProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of device profiles.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of device profile info.

methods.name: findOrCreateDeviceProfile
methods.description: Finds or creates a device profile by name.

methods.name: createDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Creates a default device profile.

methods.name: doCreateDeviceProfile
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a default device profile.

methods.name: findDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the default device profile.

methods.name: findDefaultDeviceProfileInfo
methods.description: Gets info of the default device profile.

methods.name: setDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Sets a device profile as default.

methods.name: deleteDeviceProfilesByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all device profiles for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Alias for deleting device profiles by tenant.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity by ID.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity by ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DEVICE_PROFILE.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileNamesByTenantId
methods.description: Lists device profile names for a tenant.

methods.name: findDeviceProfilesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves device profiles by a list of IDs.

methods.name: formatDeviceProfileCertificate
methods.description: Formats and hashes device profile certificates.

methods.name: fetchLeafCertificateFromChain
methods.description: Extracts the leaf certificate from a chain.

methods.name: formatCertificateValue
methods.description: Formats certificate string, trimming or processing chains.
